title: MINOR IN PSYCHOLOGY (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED Faculty of Social Science - Psychology

sections.heading: MINOR IN PSYCHOLOGY (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Admission to this module is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2029.
Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course in Psychology at the 1000 level with a mark of at least 60%
3.0 additional courses in Psychology at the 2000 level or above.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
